# Inna Guba Design

> Inna Macháč Guba is an independent designer who creates websites, brands, photos and videos for small and mid-sized businesses. One person handles the whole brand: structure, copy, design, build, photography and video, at a fixed price agreed before work starts. Studio in Brno, Czech Republic; she works with clients across Austria (including Vienna and Lower Austria) and the Czech Republic, in English, with German texts checked by a native speaker.

## Services and prices
- Website or redesign (structure, copy, design and build): from €1,490
- Brand and graphics (logo, colours, typography, presentations, print materials, social media graphics): from €690
- Photo, video and content (brand photos and videos, Reels, posts and stories): from €690
- Fixed price agreed before the start; deposit at the start, the rest on delivery
- A website usually takes 4–6 weeks; a logo, a photo shoot or a video 2–3 weeks
- Process: get in touch (reply within two working days) → design and build → launch → care after launch

## Background
- 12 years running her own photography brand, innaguba.com, which she built, wrote and photographed herself and which still brings her clients
- 5.0 on Google from 21 reviews by photography clients
- Languages: English, Czech, Ukrainian, Russian

## Case studies
- [innaguba.com](https://design.innaguba.com/work/innaguba.html): research-led redesign of a family photographer's website (interviews, survey, usability testing); a booking calendar replaced by a short inquiry form
- [Topení v cajku](https://design.innaguba.com/work/topenivcajku.html): logo, user flow, website, copy and photos for a heating engineer in the Brno region
- [Květinová farma v Javorové aleji](https://design.innaguba.com/work/herb-farm.html): brand photos and short videos commissioned by Sonnentor (Austrian organic tea and spice company) of a family flower and herb farm that supplies it; published in Sonnentor's customer magazine
- [LOUKAL](https://design.innaguba.com/work/loukal.html): three brand shoots (2024–2026) for a Czech sustainable women's fashion label, used on its website, in campaigns, on Instagram and in design stores
- [Oksamit Flora](https://design.innaguba.com/work/oksamit-flora.html): logo and brand identity for a premium online shop for cut roses from Holland: research, strategy, sketches, the Velvet Spiral logo, colour, type and packaging
